summary: Iteration 3 (JWT admin auth + Lead status tags + CSV export + logout) fully tested. 26/26 backend pytest tests passed. All 9 frontend flows on /gg-leads-dashboard verified end-to-end: login gate, wrong-cred rejection, successful login, dashboard render, status change + persistence on refresh, CSV download, contacts tab, logout with token cleared. Home page regression testids (hero, testimonials-section, services-section) all present. Public POSTs on /api/health-scan and /api/contact remain unauthenticated and fast (<5s, non-blocking email).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/admin/login uses hmac.compare_digest against plaintext password from env (ADMIN_PASSWORD). Acceptable for single-admin MVP, but consider bcrypt-hashed secret for defense-in-depth if this evolves beyond single admin.
Minor: JWT_SECRET falls back to literal 'change-me' if env var missing — should hard-fail on startup instead of silent insecure default.
Minor: No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/admin/login. Fine for MVP but worth noting.
Minor: CORS still uses allow_origins from env with default '*' plus allow_credentials=True — in prod this must be restricted to the deployed origin.
seed_data_creation: Test-created leads via POST during backend tests (prefixed TEST_). Not cleaned up; visible on dashboard. Not affecting other flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses JWT (12h expiry) via Authorization: Bearer <token> stored in localStorage under key 'gg_token'. Admin creds and JWT_SECRET are in backend/.env. Public POSTs to /api/health-scan and /api/contact remain unauthenticated. PATCH endpoints validate status against {new, contacted, closed} (400) and return 404 for unknown id. Frontend dashboard has no navbar/footer (own Layout). backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is up to date with all Iteration 3 coverage.
